# Axle shaft replacement for broken studs

> **[Unverified]** This page rests on a single community report. Cross-check before relying on it.

> Items marked **[Partial]** are only partly confirmed by the source and need more work. They stay in the review queue and are firmed up, corrected or removed as more sources come in.

## Summary

[Partial] Press out or hammer off an existing C200 automatic transmission axle shaft if broken studs are present. [t526]

## Tools

- Slide hammer [t526]
- Balls (for slide hammer) [t526]

## Tips & gotchas

- [Partial] Note that this procedure assumes an automatic transmission with a C200 axle. [t526]
- Consider buying or borrowing a full shaft assembly rather than just replacing the hub. [t526]

## Common mistakes

- [Partial] Assuming you can simply replace the hub without addressing the whole axle assembly on certain models. [t526]
